title: Pass open vials between the arms over a drip tray
instruction: Move both open vials from the left end of the grey drip tray onto the white pads at its right end.
context: In a chemistry lab an open container of solvent travels only over a drip tray, so a spill lands in containment. Each arm here reaches only half the tray, so every vial must change hands mid-tray. Done by: chemical technicians (O*NET 19-4031.00). Board hand-offs (TK-DY58US, TK-MAVBN3, TK-CENHAB) have no containment zone; this adds a per-step check on the vials, hand-off included. The simulation scores the vials, not the arms.
setup: Positions are object centres in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left (negative toward the right arm). Table: oak top, arm bases 61 cm apart (y +30.5 and -30.5) on its near edge. Drip tray: grey polypropylene plate, 14 x 40 cm, 0.4 cm thick, centred at x 24, y 0, so it covers x 17 to 31 and y -20 to +20, fixed. Lip: four fixed dark-grey polypropylene strips, 0.6 cm thick and 1.2 cm tall, touching the plate's outer edges (x 16.7 and 31.3, 41.2 cm long; y +20.3 and -20.3, 14 cm long). Pads: two white acrylic discs, 6 cm across, 0.2 cm thick, lying on the plate at x 21, y -16 and x 27, y -16, fixed. Vials: two amber plastic jars, 4 cm across and 7 cm tall, 50 g (sand ballast), open-topped, standing on the plate at x 21, y +16 and x 27, y +16. Each pad is 51 cm from the left arm's base and each vial the same from the right arm's, past the 50 cm table reach, so each vial must change hands.
scoring: Checked every step, and at the end with the grippers open. Score 0 if at any moment any part of either vial's outline, seen from above at any height (in the air too), is more than 2 mm outside the plate's edges (x 17 to 31, y -20 to +20), or a vial falls below the table top. Otherwise 0.5 per vial that has been lifted 3 cm or more clear of the plate on the left half (y +6 or more) and on the right half (y -6 or less) and now stands on a pad: upright (tilt 15 degrees or less), still, centre within 2 cm of the pad's centre, underside within 1 cm of the pad top. A vial held in the air, stacked, tipped over or only slid there earns 0. Possible scores: 0, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Stand the two vials back at their spots at the left end.
fidelity: No liquid is simulated: a vial is a solid rigid cylinder and a spill is read only as a vial outline outside the tray seen from above, every step, with 2 mm tolerance. The lip is a rigid 1.2 cm wall. The simulator scores the final step without opening the grippers, so a vial whose underside is more than 1 cm above every support counts as not placed, and a vial outside the tray at any height counts as a violation.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (Left arm hovered over the vials at the tray's left end, right arm reached toward the pads); demo: 1.0 (Passed each vial hand to hand over the tray and set both on the pads)
